title: PICT Cafeteria Billing System
description: Built a web-based billing system using React to automate receipt generation and track daily cafeteria sales. The application allows itemized billing, sales analytics, and food frequency analysis to simplify day-end reporting for the cafeteria owner.
features: Real-time billing and dynamic receipt generation.
Sales analytics dashboard for daily and item-wise reports.
Food item frequency and trend visualization.
Lightweight data persistence simulated using MySQL schema.
impact: Streamlined cafeteria billing and reporting workflows, saving manual effort and improving transparency.

title: Polymers Trading Platform
description: Developed an application enabling traders to purchase polymers online at Source.One. This platform significantly increased the daily active customer base and optimized backend performance.
features: Optimized API routes for better performance

title: Employee Tracking Mobile App
description: Developed a mobile application using Flutter to track and monitor on-field employees, locations, and industry visits. Integrated with company database for seamless syncing of employee notes and updates.
